name: Custom provider
description: Any other server: an OpenAI-compatible one, a router or proxy, or a server you run. Give its address, and annai looks for what it offers, at no cost.

provider.note: On a phone, the server needs an HTTPS address, such as a tunnel: localhost only reaches the device annai runs on. A server that never streams sends each answer whole, so annai sees nothing of it until all of it has come: if long answers stop with "No output started in time.", raise the role's "Wait for the first words" in Settings → Models, and Settings → Voice → "Wait for her first words".

responses.name: OpenAI Responses
responses.note: For servers that speak OpenAI's Responses API. If one refuses requests, try "phase": false, "nowRole": "user" or "encryptedReasoning": false in the tunables. Give a reasoning model its Reasoning levels on its page; without them it thinks without showing progress, and may run past the time limit.

messages.name: Anthropic Messages
messages.note: Give the address without /v1: Anthropic Messages adds /v1/messages itself.

realtime.name: Realtime voice
realtime.note: For a server that speaks OpenAI's Realtime API over a WebSocket, at this address plus /realtime. Add its models by id. annai gives the key as the browser's subprotocol, as OpenAI's own does.
